checks.integrity: R34/R35 source and fixture, R82 native contact bridge, dock rendering and fader geometry unchanged
checks.review: self-review; no parallel agents under the iPad loop
checks.reviewCorrections: Runtime regressions reproduced grab movement, missing extras restoration, missing accessibility space requests and shared panel-command cancellation. All now pass.

behaviour: FX, EQ and extra controls share TouchPanelState and dedicated horizontal grab lanes.
Widths are remembered independently per deck, panel and orientation for the session.
Opening FX/EQ makes room by collapsing optional extras when needed.
FX/EQ widths are bounded to prevent overlap and retain a waveform region. Closing one retains the other size.
Resize previews keep performance input gates open, including zero-width previews. Explicit hiding cancels only the affected pane.
Small clipped content rejects new contacts; existing held contacts retain their R82 mappings.
Opening a pane from compact browser strips expands performance space while retaining the library memory.
EQ/filter tabs, FX selectors, menu rows and lock targets use 44-point sizing.
limits: Physical gesture feel, focus, scrolling, FX menu access, locked-state behaviour and clean audio need Erik acceptance.
Very narrow layouts keep compact reveal lanes; extras remain unavailable until enough width is freed.
Auxiliary FX controls retain their existing vertical layout; legibility at the chosen size remains a device check.
This is a layout and input candidate, not a claim of original TDJ1 sound or gesture equivalence.
